'''David Hansen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2002 Vegas DPC]] on 12 May 2002 with YMSYL, according to Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3660">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-15-vegas-baby-lush-at-the-vegas-dpcd3660/ vegas-baby-lush-at-the-vegas-dpc], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 15 May 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-15-vegas-baby-lush-at-the-vegas-dpcd3660/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
